title: personal okrs weekly check-in - jamie li
content:
Weekly check-in / OKR draft (personal) — Jamie Li

Context:
- Role: Senior SW Engineer, Serving Runtime
- Timeframe: Q1 2026 (tracking weekly progress)
- Focus: Latency/throughput improvements, cross-team runbook drafts, mentorship

Objective 1: Improve 95th-pct latency for small-seq generation (prod routes)
- KR1.1: Reduce 95th from 220ms -> 160ms on core routes by end of Q1 (target -27%)
- KR1.2: Deploy two kernel-level optimizations and measure A/B impact
- KR1.3: Add end-to-end synthetic load test with KV-cache warmup to CI
- Progress: ~40% (kernel prototype merged to feature branch; initial bench shows 10% improvement on small sequences)
- Blockers: need GPU time on dedicated infra for full-scale tests (raised with infra team: ENG-412)

Objective 2: Reduce per-token cost for mid-tier customers via batching/cache tuning
- KR2.1: Identify top 3 routes by cost and implement batching heuristics -> expected 15% cost reduction
- KR2.2: Ship auto-cache TTL heuristic into prod config
- Progress: ~30% (route list complete; heuristic draft in repo; need to run canary)
- Blockers: telemetry gaps for tail-latency-by-model-version (filed request with observability)

Objective 3: Ramp mentorship + knowledge sharing
- KR3.1: Run 4 brown-bag sessions on runtime internals (2 completed)
- KR3.2: Pair with 2 new hires to onboard to profiling tools
- Progress: 50% (2 sessions done, onboarding paired with new hire Ravi)

This week (3/2 -> 3/4) accomplishments:
- Merged kernel prototype (feature/kv-kernel-opt) to staging
- Wrote draft load-test plan and Jenkins job sketch (TODO: add KV warmup script)
- Ran cost-route analysis, identified routes A/B/C for batching experiments
- Hosted 2nd brown-bag (profiling deep-dive)

Retrospective / Notes to self:
- What worked: short design spikes + immediate micro-benchmarks give momentum; pairing speeds onboarding
- What didn't: underestimating infra lead time for GPU clusters; need earlier sync with infra team in planning
- Decision: block for large-scale benchmarking will be escalated in weekly sync on Mon; in parallel run constrained canaries on smaller nodes to gather signal

Next week plan:
- Secure 1 dedicated run (request follow-up with infra on Mon)
- Complete canary pipeline for batching heuristic + monitor cost signals
- Add KV warmup step to CI bench (write script + small dataset)
- Prep 3rd brown-bag topic: "cost-sensitive batching patterns"

Action items (owner / due):
- Follow up infra GPU request (Jamie) / due 2026-03-06
- Finish canary pipeline PR and request review (Jamie + Maya) / due 2026-03-10
- Add observability ticket for tail-latency telemetry (Ravi) / due 2026-03-08

Loose thoughts / brainstorming (scratchpad):
- Consider a lightweight local simulator that models batching gains given arrival distribution — could accelerate experiments without full infra runs
- Could add a per-route cost SLA flag to console so product can see cost vs latency trade-offs quickly
- Draft for runbook: graceful fallback -> route to smaller model variant w/ notice header to callers

Notes: this is a working doc — will move into Confluence when OKR language stabilizes.
